prompt.content: What was the name of the theater where The Big Lebowski received its world premiere at the 1998 Sundance Film Festival?

output:
The Big Lebowski, directed by the Coen Brothers, had its world premiere at the 1998 Sundance Film Festival at the Eccles Theater.

The Eccles Theater, located at the corner of 15th and Market Streets in Park City, Utah, was the site of the film's world premiere.
